controls.label: Midas Ethereum upgrade path - 1/3 Safe through 2-day timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, all three mint-critical transparent proxies shared ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac. Its owner was MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852 with a 172800-second delay. Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 was the timelock's sole proposer, executor, and canceller; it was 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25527148, the current mF-ONE direct minters were EOA 0x4f75307888fd06b16594cc93ed478625ad65eeea and DepositVault proxy 0x41438435c20b1c2f1fca702d387889f346a0c3de. The previously recorded 0x9419bfccf62469dd3abac731cac3fb24f5b8edaf was only a vault operator, not a live token minter. Safe 0xb60842e9dabcd1c52e354ac30e82a97661cb7e89 and EOA 0xd4195cf4df289a4748c1a7b6ddbe770e27ba1227 each held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could immediately change the role set. The complete mint-critical proxy inventory was token 0x238a700ed6165261cf8b2e544ba797bc11e466ba, DepositVault 0x41438435c20b1c2f1fca702d387889f346a0c3de, and shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b, with implementations 0x32fb951ce9be3cd9a0a406ea86647a3c7d6406e2, 0xe802e0c7a2a65dd72926aa34c27236c83a80be50, and 0xdd5a54ba2ab379a5e642c58f98ad793a183960e2 respectively. Each EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to ProxyAdmin 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac, owned by the 172800-second Midas timelock. The timelock's sole initiating Safe was 1-of-3 with no enabled modules and a zero guard. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: the Midas Attestation Engine creates periodic NAV and proof-of-reserve checkpoints, with source documents notarized by vLayer and independently verified by LlamaRisk or Canary; the live dashboard was reviewed on 2026-07-15.
